text:
maria: Starting thread — planning the midnight migration in the 01:00-03:00 PT change window. Need cross-service alignment for API/runtime/console/router.

aj: Quick checklist: runtime kernel pin, API schema bump, console route mapping, router header flag.

ravi: Runtime will need v2.3.1 kernel; I recommend pinning for the window and a canary on 2% traffic.

elaine: Console has a small schema tweak for route metadata, backwards-compatible but will require a console config reload. No DB changes.

simon: Router change is a header-based steering rule; config lives in teams/router, I can stage it and keep a fallback route.

aj: Deploy bot preflight? @deploy-bot run preflight --services=api,runtime,console,router --window=01:00-03:00PT

deploy-bot: Preflight started at 7065432118. Running smoke + integration checks. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/migration/7065432109

maria: Decision points: pin runtime image to v2.3.1, API to v1.14.0, console to 3.2.0-alpha? (just the config), router rule staged with fallback. Rollback triggers: >2% error rate or p95 latency +200ms sustained for 5m. Agree?

aj: agree. Also add quick health check for KV cache misses — runtime kv miss spike >15% for 3m = rollback.

ravi: I'll pin runtime with rdctl and open a short-lived pin.

ravi: ```
rdctl release pin runtime v2.3.1 --until=2026-04-02T04:00:00Z
rdctl release pin api v1.14.0 --until=2026-04-02T04:00:00Z
```

elaine: Console config reload command (staged):
```
kubectl -n console rollout restart deploy/console-config --context=cluster-prod
```

sre-oncall: I'll watch infra metrics and keep the pager on. If we see p95 up +200ms for >5m or increased 5xxs, I'll trigger rollback.

maria: Release notes snippet for comms channel: "Midnight change window: runtime v2.3.1 kernel pin, API v1.14.0, console config reload for route metadata, router header steering staged. Rollback on errors/latency/kv-miss spike." Link to full notes: https://docs.internal/releases/7065432109

aj: One more: canary slice -> 2% for 10m, then 20% for 10m, then 100% if green. Manual hold between steps.

simon: Router fallback checked. If header rule fails, traffic falls back to legacy pool automatically.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout step 1 -> 2% started at 7065432128.

maria: Monitoring dashboards pinned: api/latency, runtime/p95, runtime/kv_miss, console/errors, router/fallback_count. All leads have access.

sre-oncall: Noted. I'll post a short update at +15m and +45m.

aj: If anything looks off we hold at current slice and exec rollback checklist:
- pause rollout (deploy-bot)
- unpin images if needed
- revert console reload if it caused issues (kubectl rollout undo)
- route switch back to legacy pool

maria: Sounds good. Final readiness: @ravi confirm pin applied? @deploy-bot confirm canary started?

ravi: Pin applied and verified in release registry.

deploy-bot: Canary 2% succeeded after 10m. Waiting for manual approval to proceed to 20%. Reaction: :thumbsup: from maria, elaine.

maria: Approving move to 20%. Please keep manual hold.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 20% at 7065432140. Will wait 10m and post health.

sre-oncall: Monitoring — no spikes so far. If anything changes I'll call it out.

maria: Thanks everyone. Keep channel open and short updates only unless we need to escalate.
